passages.note: A No vote on a firearms-advertising-to-minors bill, off the ownership/carry/background-check axis this ladder orders.
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 57 Noes Count 15 NVR Count 8

passages.provision_quote: A firearm industry member shall not advertise, market, or arrange for placement of an advertising or marketing communication concerning any firearm-related product in a manner that is designed, intended, or reasonably appears to be attractive to minors.
passages.note: The bill's operative clause restricts firearm marketing to minors, not ownership, carrying, or background-check rules that separate these rungs.

rows.reasoning: The only evidence is Lackey's No vote and the text of AB 2571 (2021-2022), which restricts firearm advertising and marketing to minors. It does not address civilian ownership, assault-style weapon bans, background checks, or carry-permit rules, the clauses that separate these rungs, so no rung is established.
